content.text:
Operations and supply chain analyst with 5+ years of experience supporting regional distribution,
vendor performance, inventory planning, and process improvement across Indonesia and Singapore-
linked operations. Strong in Excel, SQL, dashboarding, and cross-functional coordination with
warehouse, procurement, and commercial teams.

bullets:
Built weekly inventory and order-fulfilment dashboards for 6 distribution points, improving
visibility of stock ageing and service levels.

Reduced manual reporting time by approximately 35% by consolidating shipment, warehouse, and
sales data into repeatable Excel and SQL workflows.
Supported carrier and 3PL performance reviews using on-time delivery, damage-rate, and cost-
per-order metrics.
Coordinated root-cause reviews for fulfilment exceptions and documented corrective actions
with warehouse and customer-service teams.
Maintained demand and replenishment reports for fast-moving consumer goods across West Java.

Prepared supplier scorecards and purchase-order tracking reports for procurement and finance
stakeholders.
Helped standardize monthly stock reconciliation between warehouse records and ERP extracts.
Assisted with delivery scheduling, daily shipment logs, and warehouse documentation.
Prepared simple KP! summaries for route completion and delivery exceptions.

paragraphs: Microsoft Excel, SQL, Power BI, KPI dashboards, basic Python
Inventory analysis, order fulfilment, supplier performance, 3PL coordination
Synthetic resume generated for testing/demo purposes - all personal details are fictional.
